note: Feature areas of the project-tracker-xl contract (v1's project-tracker plus 21 areas). Each hidden test is tagged with exactly one area id. `section` is the instruction.md heading that defines the area (section 0, Conventions, applies to every area: its error order, event pipeline, scheduler, pagination and validation rules are tested inside the areas). `routes` are the routes the area owns, exactly as instruction.md's route tables spell them. `must_cover` lists behaviours the area's tests should reach; every one of them is written in instruction.md. `half` splits the areas into two sets of roughly equal test count, so the hidden tests can be written in two parallel tickets without overlap. This file is kit-side: it is not copied into the workspace.

areas.title: Accounts and auth
must_cover: register validation (email, password length, name, handle regex) and the user shape without password
email_taken (case-insensitive) before handle_taken
login token >= 20 chars not starting with trk_, expiresAt = now + tokenTtlMs; invalid_credentials
401 unauthorized for missing, malformed, unknown, revoked and expired tokens (fake clock)
logout revokes only the calling token
password change: wrong_password; success revokes every session token but no API key
PATCH /me handle conflict and own-handle no-op

areas.title: Teams and roles
must_cover: creator is owner; plan is defaultPlan; myRole per caller; GET /teams lists only the caller's teams
non-members get 404 not_found, never 403, on every team-scoped route
role matrix: viewer/member get 403 on admin+ routes; admin gets 403 on owner routes
add member: user_not_found, already_member, role owner rejected, members quota after already_member
owner_required on changing or removing the owner
self-removal by a member; removal of someone else by a member is 403
leaving cascades: cards unassigned (archived included), watching stops, private views deleted, user field values removed; no updatedAt change
transfer: target becomes owner, previous owner admin, non-member target 400
deleting a team removes it for every member

areas.title: Projects
must_cover: key regex and key_taken within a team (archived included); same key allowed in another team; projects quota after key_taken
PATCH with key is 400 invalid_body; updatedAt changes
?archived=false|true|all and invalid_query
archived project: writes to boards, columns, cards, comments, fields, sprints, checklist, attachments answer 409 project_archived; watching and timer stop still work; unarchive restores writes
delete cascades (its boards, cards, fields, sprints answer 404; storage freed)

areas.title: Boards and columns
must_cover: default columns To do / In progress / Done with positions 0..2 and categories todo / in_progress / done; category rule for custom column lists
insert a column at a position; positions stay 0..n-1
move a column with PATCH position; relative order of the others kept
wipLimit and category validation
changing a category to or from done sets or clears completedAt of its cards without touching updatedAt
delete: last_column, column_not_empty (archived cards ignored), ?moveTo appends cards in order, invalid moveTo is invalid_query
member is 403 on column and board writes

areas.title: Cards
must_cover: full card shape with defaults (priority none, points null, sprintId null, customFields {}, checklist {0,0}, blocked false, completedAt, archived false)
number per project across boards, never reused after delete; key PROJECT-N
labels normalised: trimmed, lowercased, de-duplicated, sorted; more than 10 is 400
dueDate, priority, points and sprintId validation
assignee: viewer, non-member and unknown id are invalid_assignee; null clears; validation order invalid_body then invalid_assignee then field values
create at a position shifts later cards; delete closes the gap
move across columns and within a column with exact resulting positions; move to another board's column is 400
completedAt set on entering a done column, kept between done columns, cleared on leaving
blocked card cannot enter a done column (409 blocked) but can be created there and leave it
wip_limit_reached on create and on move into a full column; reorder inside a full column allowed; cards quota on create
due job: card.due emitted when the clock passes the start of dueDate on the next request, once; cancelled by clearing the date; skipped for completed or archived cards
GET /boards/:boardId/cards order and ?columnId= filter; foreign columnId is invalid_query

areas.title: Comments and mentions
must_cover: threaded replies returned as nested trees, oldest first, any depth
parentId on another card is 400 invalid_body
mention regex edge cases: email addresses, uppercase, punctuation, 21-char names, non-members, the author
mentions recomputed on PATCH
PATCH by a non-author (even the owner) is 403; DELETE by admin allowed, by another member 403
soft delete keeps replies; PATCH/DELETE/reply on a deleted comment is comment_deleted; card_archived on archived cards
GET /me/mentions newest first with cursor pagination

areas.title: Search
must_cover: prefix term matching over title, description and non-deleted comments; every term must match
score 3*t + d + c and its tie-break by creation order
filters: projectId, boardId, columnId, assigneeId and none, repeated label, dueFrom/dueTo inclusive
new filters: priority, sprintId and none, category, blocked, with invalid_query on bad values
archived projects excluded unless includeArchived=true; archived cards never returned
cursor pagination visits every match once; total; invalid limit/cursor/date are invalid_query
q longer than 200 chars or with more than 10 terms is invalid_query; results never include another team's cards

areas.title: Webhooks
must_cover: secret only on create and rotate; generated secret >= 32 chars; webhooks quota on create
events validation against the section 0.8 table, de-dup and sort, * normalisation
a local receiver gets { id, event, teamId, actorId, via, occurredAt, data } with the documented headers; signature verifies with HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body
events from rule actions carry via { type: rule, ruleId, runId } and the rule creator as actorId; deliveries in queue order
inactive webhooks get nothing but ping; events filter respected
retry with small retryDelaysMs: 500 then 200 gives attempts 2 and succeeded; same body bytes, attempt header increments
exhausted retries give failed; a timeout gives a non-empty lastError and lastStatusCode null
deliveries newest first; member gets 403 on webhook routes

areas.title: Rate limiting
must_cover: headers x-ratelimit-limit, -remaining, -reset on counted requests (fake clock)
429 rate_limited with retry-after and remaining 0, and no side effect
429s are not counted; budget per credential: two tokens, and an API key apart from its owner's tokens
a request failing at 3a or later still counts; an idempotent replay counts
a new window (clock moved) restores the budget
public routes (GET /plans included) and 401s carry no headers and are not counted

areas.title: Persistence (version 2 data file)
must_cover: the file exists and is version 2 right after a mutating response, including pipeline effects (no debounce)
a new app on the same file sees everything: logins, tokens, API keys, ids, positions, next card number, rules and runs, notifications
pending jobs (due job, recurrence) survive a restart and run when due
no plain-text password or API key secret in the file
missing file is an empty state; createApp throws on invalid JSON and on an unsupported version

areas.title: Migration from the 1.x format
must_cover: v1.bak byte-identical and dataFile rewritten as version 2 before createApp returns
migrated users log in with their 1.x passwords; emails lowercased; derived handles including collisions and short handles
role mapping manager/editor/reader, member order, plan = defaultPlan
columns, wipLimit from limits, categories by position, orphan column cards land in the first column, positions from order with ties
labels from tags, dueDate from UTC timestamps, assignee dropped for viewers and non-members, completedAt for cards in done columns, one history entry per card
card numbers per project by createdAt with ties in file order; next card number continues
comment parentId kept only for the same card; mentions recomputed with migrated handles
areas.fixture: input/fixtures/tracker-v1.json (byte-identical to project-tracker's; hidden tests must carry their own copy, since the agent can edit the workspace)

areas.title: Audit log
must_cover: one entry per change with the documented action, target, details and via, for requests, rule actions and jobs
rule actions add their own entries after the request's (card.updated with fields [labels], card.moved, comment.created, sprint.cards_added)
failed requests, reads, /me routes, watching, cascades, the due job and dry-run imports add nothing
fields in *.updated details are the sorted body fields
newest first with cursor pagination; action and actorId filters
member and viewer get 403

areas.title: API keys
must_cover: create returns secret trk_ + >= 32 chars once; prefix is its first 12 chars; list and get never show it
name, scope, teamId and expiresAt validation; PATCH with scope or teamId is 400; 20 keys per user is quota_exceeded
a key authenticates as its owner with the owner's current role; deleted and expired keys are 401
api_key_not_allowed on logout, PATCH /me, password, /me/api-keys routes, invite accept, and POST /teams for a team-restricted key
insufficient_scope: read key on writes, write key on admin+ and owner routes, checked before 404
team-restricted key: other teams 404 and left out of GET /teams, mentions, notifications
another user's key id is 404

areas.title: Plans and quotas
must_cover: GET /plans is public and lists the exact limits table
GET /teams/:teamId/plan usage counts: archived projects and cards, inactive webhooks, disabled rules, distinct sha256 storage
quota_exceeded with details { resource, limit, used } for projects, cards, members, webhooks, rules, recurrences, storageBytes at the documented check position
fixed limits: fields 30 per project, checklist items 50 per card, API keys 20 per user
PUT plan: owner only; downgrade_blocked with resources in table order changes nothing; same plan is a no-op without audit; plan_changed audit entry
defaultPlan option applies to new and migrated teams

areas.title: Idempotency keys
must_cover: a repeated POST with the same key and body replays status and body bytes with idempotency-replayed: true and no second effect (one card, one audit entry, one delivery)
same key, different body is 409 idempotency_conflict
invalid header values are 400 invalid_header
error responses store nothing; the same key on another path, method or user is unrelated
records expire after idempotencyTtlMs (fake clock) and are not persisted across a restart
PATCH, PUT and DELETE ignore the header

areas.title: Custom fields
must_cover: field definitions: name uniqueness case-insensitive, type immutable, options rules per type, 30-field quota
value validation for each of the 8 types with invalid_field_value details.fieldId (first offending key in body order)
create/PATCH merge semantics: null ignored on create, null removes on PATCH; PUT and DELETE routes return the card and emit card.updated [customFields]
required fields: field_required on create, on PATCH null, on DELETE; making a field required checks nothing
search field.<id> conditions per type, checkbox false matches unset in the field's project only, bad number/checkbox values invalid_query
options change removes stale select/multiselect values from cards and templates without updatedAt change
deleting a field removes values and disables referencing rules

areas.title: Team labels
must_cover: label name normalisation, uniqueness (label_taken), color validation and lowercase default #888888, list by name
rename rewrites cards (archived projects and cards included), templates, recurrences, rule conditions and actions, view queries; arrays re-sorted and de-duplicated; no updatedAt change, no events
delete removes the name from cards, templates, recurrences and views and disables rules that use it
merge rewrites everywhere into the target (rules not disabled) and deletes the source; intoLabelId of another team is 400

areas.title: Dependencies
must_cover: add a blocker: same team any project, not itself (400), dependency_exists
dependency_cycle with details.path from the BFS in link creation order, including the direct two-card case
blocked is true only while an open blocker exists (not completed, not archived)
blocked cards answer 409 blocked when moved into a done column; the move_to_column action fails with blocked
blockers and blocking lists in link creation order; DELETE of a non-blocker is 404
project_archived and card_archived apply when either card qualifies; deleting a card removes its links

areas.title: Sprints and velocity
must_cover: sprint create validation (dates, endDate >= startDate) and list order with ?state
state machine: start only planned (sprint_state), one active per project (sprint_active), complete only active
committedPoints at start and completedPoints at complete from non-archived cards, null points as 0
complete carries open cards to a planned sprint or to none; completed cards keep sprintId
PATCH and DELETE restrictions by state; delete clears sprintId by cascade
POST cards emits card.updated [sprintId] per changed card and one sprint.cards_added audit entry; card PATCH sprintId validation
burndown per date with null for future dates and remaining computed from completedAt against the end of each date
velocity: most recently completed first, count, average rounded to 2 decimals or null

areas.title: Checklists
must_cover: item create/insert/move/delete with positions 0..n-1
done toggling sets and clears doneAt and doneBy; same value keeps them
card checklist summary { total, done }; card updatedAt unchanged
checklist.completed emitted exactly when the last undone item is done or deleted, never on instantiation
50-item quota; card_archived and project_archived

areas.title: Card templates
must_cover: template validation including customFields values and checklist entries
instantiate: columnId in the project, title override, placeholders {{date}} {{user}} {{number}} {{project}} replaced, others kept, title cut to 200
instantiated card takes labels, priority, points, values and gets checklist items; one card.created event and audit entry
required fields checked on instantiate (field_required); quota and WIP limit apply
delete of a template used by a recurrence is template_in_use

areas.title: Recurring cards
must_cover: recurrence validation: exactly one of templateId and title, schedule shapes per frequency, dates, recurrences quota
occurrence dates for daily, weekly (Monday-based week intervals), monthly (short months clamp to the last day) and endDate
nextRunAt is the first occurrence later than now, null when inactive or finished; recomputed on PATCH
the scheduler runs on any request (including /health and 401s) and creates exactly one card per run even after missed occurrences
run failures recorded in lastError in the documented order (forbidden, project_archived, quota_exceeded, wip_limit_reached, invalid_assignee, field_required) with no card
a run's card.created carries via recurrence and triggers rules; occurrences route lists the next count instants
column delete moves the recurrence to moveTo or deletes it

areas.title: Automation rules
must_cover: rule validation: trigger events and filters (projectId, toColumnId, fields), condition fields and ops per type, action shapes, archive_card last; rules quota
conditions evaluated on the current card state, every op of the table including customFields per type and missing values
actions mirror their routes: set_assignee, add_label, remove_label, set_priority, move_to_column, set_field, add_comment with placeholders, notify, add_to_sprint (id and active), archive_card
action outcomes: noop when nothing changes, failed with the documented code, later actions not_run, earlier changes kept
runs: skipped (forbidden, not_found, project_archived, card_archived), no_match, succeeded, failed; recorded with depth; runs lists newest first with ?status
pipeline order: the response shows the state after rules; event snapshots before them; rules in creation order see earlier rules' changes
chains across rules up to automation.maxDepth; a rule never reacts to its own actions
rule changes appear in audit with via, in activity, in webhooks, and in notifications (add_comment mentions)
referenced project, column, field or sprint deletion disables the rule; re-enabling with a missing reference is 400
POST /rules/:ruleId/test answers per-condition booleans without effects

areas.title: Notifications and watchers
must_cover: auto-watch on create, assignment and comment; watch and unwatch idempotent; watchers in watching order
mention, comment, assigned, moved and due notifications to the right recipients, never the actor, one per user per event
assigned only when the assignee actually changes to a non-null user
settings: type switches and mutedProjectIds suppress creation; PUT validation (exactly seven keys)
visibility: only while a member of the team (invite always); other ids 404
read, unread, read-all (optional teamId), unread-count, delete; ?unread filter and cursor pagination newest first
rule notify notifications created when the action runs, rule creator included

areas.title: Attachments
must_cover: raw-body upload with filename query validation, contentType from the header up to ';' or application/octet-stream, size and sha256
content route returns the exact bytes with content-type, content-length and quoted etag; If-None-Match gives 304
1 MiB body limit (413) and empty body 400
storage quota counts distinct sha256 per team; re-uploading known bytes adds nothing; delete frees bytes only when no other copy remains
attachment.added event and audit details { sha256, size }; card_archived and project_archived

areas.title: Activity and card history
must_cover: one activity entry per event with projectId and cardId rules, including rule-caused events with via
team feed with event and actorId filters, project, card and me feeds newest first with pagination
card history: creation, every move including within a column and by rules, restore; cascades record nothing

areas.title: Saved views
must_cover: private views are invisible (404) to others; shared views visible to every member
viewer may create private but not shared views (403); PATCH/DELETE rights for owner and admin+
query validation per search parameter (invalid_body), unknown keys dropped, labels normalised
GET /views/:viewId/cards equals search with the stored query, with total and pagination

areas.title: Import and export
must_cover: JSON project document with exact key order, board/column indexes, field names, emails, checklist
CSV export header, cell formatting and RFC 4180 quoting, CRLF line ends, content-type
CSV import: header errors (unknown_column, missing_column), row errors with row/column/code ordering, malformed rows
CSV import creates and updates cards, moves between columns, ignores WIP; dryRun changes nothing; one audit entry; no events or rules
team import: first invalid value as a JSON Pointer path, key override, key_taken, quotas
round trip: export, import into another team, export again gives the same document except key/name overrides

areas.title: Reports
must_cover: summary counts by category, priority, assignee (null first), label; overdue against today; blocked; points
cycle time from the first in_progress history entry, with average, median (even count) and p85 nearest-rank
flow: per date counts from history at the end of each date with current categories; at most 92 dates; from/to validation
time report by user and card within the date range
workload per member+ in member order over non-archived projects
archived cards are left out everywhere

areas.title: HTML pages
must_cover: content-type text/html; doctype and title formats
board page sections per column with data attributes, cards by position, assignee and labels; archived cards left out

card page dl fields in order, description newlines as
, nested comment trees, deleted comments
escaping of & < > " ' in text and attributes, and nothing else
summary and notifications pages; errors stay JSON

areas.title: Invitations
must_cover: create with token once, already_member, replacing a pending invite, invite notification for a registered user
expiry via invites.ttlMs and the fake clock; status filter including expired
accept: 404 unknown token, 403 for another email, invite_used, invite_expired, members quota; member.added emitted
decline and revoke state rules; GET /me/invites lists pending ones for the caller's email

areas.title: Archive and trash
must_cover: archive: position null, gap closed, hidden from board lists, search, sprints, reports, WIP counts; still in GET /cards and exports
writes to an archived card answer card_archived; delete, restore, watch and timer stop still work
restore: column and position, WIP check, completedAt rules, history entry, card_not_archived
trash list newest archivedAt first; purge after trash.retentionMs with card.deleted and card.purged audit, actor null

areas.title: Time tracking
must_cover: manual entries: minutes 1..1440, date not after today, note; minutesLogged on the card
one running timer per user across teams (timer_running); stop on another card is no_timer; minutes rounding and cap
GET /me/timer; delete by the entry's user or admin+
time.logged and time.deleted audit entries; no events
